text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our way back to campus, we pass by
the park
where the rascals' leader hangs
out, but she's
nowhere to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I guess she's not here today either... I
haven't seen
her around at all recently.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm worried she's bedridden from eating
too much
food. Or maybe she pulled a
muscle practicing a
Princess Fighter
transformation sequence...

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Rascal
text_block_list.text:
If you're looking for the boss, you won't
find her
here anymore.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Rascal
text_block_list.text: Yeah. She's moving away.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What?! She's moving?! She didn't say
anything
about that to me!

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Rascal
text_block_list.text:
That's what I think too. She told her
other friends
not to go see her off
either...
choice_data_list: ……さよならするのが辛いのかも

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's... I won't accept it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No matter how painful it might be,
parting
without saying a proper goodbye
isn't
princess-like in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, tell me where she lives, right
NOW!

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Rascal
text_block_list.text:
Y-you won't make it in time! She said
she'd be
gone by this evening!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if she's already departed... A
princess
won't fail to catch up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We hurry to the address the boy shared
with us,
only to see a car leaving in the
distance.

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Rascal
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... It's no good. We're too late!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Not so! We're just in time! I can see her
baseball
cap through the rear window!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Catching a car will be a piece of cake for
a
princess! Graaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess bolts off at full speed
and
rapidly gains ground on the
traveling car!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Stop right theeere! PLEEEASE!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She shouts at the top of her lungs,
running side by
side with the car.
Eventually, it comes to a stop.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Wearing a Cap
text_block_list.text: I-I, um...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I understand. You were upset. Being
separated
from you is hard for me too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
However! That doesn't mean you can just

disappear without saying a proper
farewell! All
you're doing is running from
reality!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's not the conduct of a princess! If
you run
away now, then what's that
mean for you in your
new home?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Every princess must face times of
struggle,
discontent, and sadness. Today
is one of those
times...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's why you must meet the challenge
head-on
and carve a path forward!
That's how you
demonstrate your
princessly spirit!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So promise me one thing! When you
encounter
difficulties in your new town,
face them with
everything you have!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If you can do that, you'll be fine! And I
know
you'll make a bunch of new friends
in no time at
all!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Wearing a Cap
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... All right, Sis!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If there's ever a time when you feel like
you're
losing heart, then watch one of
my races on TV.
Seeing a princess in
action will remind you of
what's
important!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Wearing a Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll watch. I'll definitely watch you!
'Cause... 'cause
we're...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Wearing a Cap
text_block_list.text: We're friends forever, right?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! We're true friends! Princess pals!
Princess
sisters!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After saying her goodbyes, Kawakami
Princess
watches the car depart with a
gentle expression
on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In that expression, I see a hint of her
beloved
Princess Fighter—a heroine who
proudly fights on
to protect the peace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue

Princess Fighter—a heroine who
proudly fights on
to protect the peace.

Wha—?! That would be amazing if it

I'm already raring to go!

have to keep racing for?

Whatever! I could race for a hundred

need be!

Of course, I'm counting on you to stick
with me
the whole way!

Huh? O-oh, yes. I suppose they would
